title: Why Time Flies When You Are Having Fun
hook: Ever notice how a great day vanishes, but a boring one drags?

narration.text: Your brain actually warps time perception, depending on your engagement level.
When excited, your attention focuses outwards, processing many new stimuli.
This intense external focus means less internal monitoring of the clock.
Conversely, boredom makes you hyper-aware of every passing second.
Your mind lacks external stimulation, so it fixates on internal timekeeping.
This makes minutes feel like hours, enhancing the feeling of duration.
So, to make time fly, simply find something truly engaging to do.
What activity always makes time vanish for you?

description: Discover the fascinating psychological reason why your perception of time changes so dramatically. Learn how your brain's attention focus literally warps minutes into hours and vice-versa. It's all about how you engage with the world around you.
topic: Why you perceive time differently when you are having fun compared to being bored.
